security.passwordStorage: scrypt with a random per-account salt
security.sessionCookie: opaque random token, HttpOnly, SameSite=Lax, Secure in production
security.serverSessionStorage: SHA-256 token hash with server-side expiry
security.signOut: deletes the server-side session and clears the cookie
